brief.en: Freezes and damages an entire lane of zombies
brief.zh: 伤害并冻住一整行的僵尸

description.en: Chilly Peppers freeze and damage an entire lane of zombies, chilling zombies in nearby lanes.
description.zh: 寒冰辣椒伤害并冻住整行的僵尸，并且使相邻的僵尸减速。

chat.en: "Get up and freeze the day!! Chilly Pepper might look innocent and unassuming but deep down he's cold as ice. Compare him to Jalapeño and watch him EXPLODE!"
chat.zh: “起来吧，冻住今天！寒冰辣椒外表看起来无辜又谦逊，但骨子里却冷若冰霜。拿他和火辣椒比比看，看他立马炸给你看！”
